answer: Publicly auditable vouching: each new identity must be vouched by an established agent who risks their own standing, and the voucher's score decays in proportion to any later slash on the newcomer. Scaling to N fakes costs N credible sponsors, and every caught fake leaves a glacier of evidence the network replays. The echo of a bad vouch never fully fades, while the ripple of each slash deters the next attempt, so mass registration stays unprofitable.
